data.other_hard: exchange must be abroad and last at least 2 months consecutive; must earn course credits; must not receive an Erasmus, NL Scholarship Programme or Radboud Honours Academy grant; must not have received a NL or Individual Travel Grant during current study cycle; must leave more than 2 weeks after application; trip must have extra expenses (tickets, visa, accommodation, vaccinations); study programme or faculty must approve the trip; compensation covers maximum 4 months; documents must be uploaded at least 2 weeks before departure
data.evidence_sentence: you are registered as a student (full-time) in a bachelor or Master's study programme at Radboud University
data.notes: Page is a Radboud University regulation for travel grants; no nationality rule or minimum GPA is stated. Applications open around May each year for the following academic year, but no fixed closing date is given; the deadline is at least 2 weeks before departure, so deadline is set to rolling. Host country is not fixed since the funded stay is abroad at any destination. Expense amounts are not stated.
